column1: # NGPC hardware names: the single source for the C++ tables and data/ngpc_hw.inc.
# Rebuilt from Toshiba IO900H.H (TMP95C061F) and SNK developer docs only; every entry cites its source:
#   IO900H.H l.N (docs/toshiba/IO900H.H), or SNK DOC, SECTION / SNK DOC §X-Y (docs/snk/DOC/DOC.md).
# docs/hardware-names.md explains the groups, the naming rule and what stays unnamed.
#   name  ADDR  NAME  SIZE  KIND  CITATION  OFFICIAL  (sorted by address)
#     KIND: io (CPU on-chip I/O), sysram (system work RAM), vector (interrupt vector slot),
#           k2ge (K2GE register), mem (memory area); SIZE: register width, or area length for mem
#     NAME: official spelling normalized (uppercase, "." -> "_"); ours where SNK gives no name
#   bit   REG   NAME  BIT   CITATION  OFFICIAL   (mask = 1 << BIT; SysWork names are SNK's)
#   section KIND TITLE  (comment headers of ngpc_hw.inc, in order)
